title: Too Soft
text: Too Soft. Great scent, when the smell is actually in the air. It's a very, very soft smell; for those who do not like strong scents.

product_metadata.title: Yankee Candle Elevation Collection with Platform Lid Passionflower Scented Candle, Large 2-Wick, 80 Hour Burn Time
features: Like the rare and heady scents of night blooming flowers, Passionflower brings together an inspiring and uplifting blend of kaffir lime, pink jasmine tea, lotus blossom, and vanilla orchid
This decor candle features soft corners and an updated silhouette perfect for showcasing your style in any room
19. 5 ounce candle burn time: 65 to 80 hours
Brushed metal lid fits nicely under the candle to create a pedestal
Premium grade colored soy blend wax delivers a clean, consistent burn
description: Styled with a unique and contemporary silhouette, the Yankee Candle Elevation Collection with Platform Lid features a specially designed lid that securely fits into the bottom of the glass, acting as a pedestal and creating a unified look. The collection balances high-quality glass and minimalist lines, resulting in a distinct shape that complements the style of any home. A smooth soy wax blend and fresh, layered fragrances lead to an enjoyable, room-filling experience.
